fig1.title: Gold Ore — hourly median price and the 7-day forecast
fig1.sub: Jan 20 – Feb 5, 2026 · price per unit · 6,164 listings aggregated by hour · band = daily 25–75% · shaded = 95% CI
fig1.caption: Exhibit 1. The market fell from ~95 to ~20 over the collection window. The ensemble calls a short rebound and then a drop on day 7, where its confidence band widens to ±8 — the signal to wait rather than trade.

fig2.title: Model comparison on the held-out 20%
fig2.sub: bar = R² on the test split · dot = 5-fold cross-validation mean ± σ
fig2.caption: Exhibit 2. Four linear models fit the test split best, but the voting ensemble is the one that is both accurate and stable (CV 0.995 ± 0.001). SVR and Extra Trees were dropped from the final vote.

fig3.title: The pipeline, with its numbers
fig3.caption: Exhibit 3. Every stage reports a number; the decision at the end carries the risk level with it.

fig1.title: 黄金矿石——小时中位价与 7 日预测
fig1.sub: 2026-01-20 至 02-05 · 单位价格 · 6,164 条挂单按小时聚合 · 浅带 = 当日 25–75% 分位 · 着色 = 95% 置信区间
fig1.caption: 图 1. 采集窗口内价格从约 95 跌到约 20。集成模型预测短暂回升后在第 7 天回落，此时置信区间扩大到 ±8——这是该观望而不是交易的信号。

fig2.title: 各模型在留出 20% 上的表现
fig2.sub: 条 = 测试集 R² · 点 = 5 折交叉验证均值 ± σ
fig2.caption: 图 2. 四个线性模型在测试集上拟合最好，但只有投票集成既准又稳（交叉验证 0.995 ± 0.001）。SVR 与极端随机树未进入最终投票。

fig3.title: 管道各环节及其数字
fig3.caption: 图 3. 每个环节都有可核对的数字；最后的结论连同风险等级一起给出。
